content.title: Chapter 2
content.subtitle: Creating an Enabling Environment for an Innovation-Driven Energy Transition
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the second chapter of the Future of Energy Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.

nextBlock.title: Chapter 3: Action
nextBlock.cta: This chapter explores some innovations—decentralized systems, energy storage, and circular economy—that enhance resilience, access, and sustainability in the energy transition.
